That qualifier is the substantive content a reuser needs. The pass is qualified: no formal method is named, recorded as a low-severity issue.

Note that sampling_strategies.source_data discloses donor demographics for both lines (a 51-year-old black female; a healthy male Northern European donor); these are standard published cell-line attributes and do not contradict the deidentification claim.

strengths: Exceptional identifier hygiene throughout: a valid Dataverse DOI reused consistently as id, latest_version_doi and subset namespace, ORCID identifiers for the great majority of 45 creators, ROR for institutions, Cellosaurus RRIDs for both cell lines, and B2AI ontology CURIEs on every instance.

Complete and typed version lineage: four predecessor releases each named, dated and separately resolvable by DOI with is_new_version_of relationships, plus a stated custodian for the version history and a funded long-term preservation commitment.

Limitations disclosure that tells a user what not to do with the release: typed limitations with stated consequences, including that predicted cell maps are absent, that the three modalities cover incompletely overlapping protein sets, and that some components remain embargoed, reinforced by matching discouraged_uses entries.

Coherent and non-circular privacy and governance account for a non-human-subjects dataset: the no-participants determination is corroborated independently by the description, the collection mechanisms, direct_collection and the cell-line RRIDs, while a named Ethics Module, two ORCID-identified review contacts and a Data Access Committee with a described review process supply real oversight documentation.

Verifiable funding transparency: NIH award identifiers that parse correctly against agency patterns, with core project number, application ID, supplement number, project period, awarding organisation and PI given for the primary award.

Disciplined and unusually explicit source handling: the record discloses conflicting source values (464 versus 563 imaged proteins, one creator's affiliation) with the ranking rule it applied, and accounts in source_caveats for values it deliberately omits, such as byte counts, collection timeframes and last_updated_on.
weaknesses: No software is documented for producing or transforming the distributed data. Three collections are typed processed_data, yet the only named tools are the MuSIC cell-map pipeline whose outputs the record says are not in this release, FAIRSCAPE packaging, IMP structure modelling and a 10x capture kit.

No variable-level metadata anywhere: the columns, units and identifier namespaces of the SEC-MS tables, AP-MS interaction records and perturb-seq atlas matrices are undocumented, which is the single largest obstacle to integrating this release with other datasets.
Payload formats and encodings are unspecified: only the ZIP container and the RO-Crate packaging standard are declared, with no format, media_type or encoding on any file collection resource.
No change log and no errata across a four-release history, so a user upgrading from the October 2025 release cannot tell what was added, re-issued or corrected.

Version numbering is non-monotonic: this June 2026 release is version 2.0 while the June and October 2025 releases are recorded at version 2.1, which breaks the ordering needed to identify the current release.

No data anomalies or missing-data documentation for any modality, despite an antibody-scoring quality process being named without reported outcomes and CRISPR screen quality control being described only as in progress.
recommendations: Name the software that produced the released files, with versions: the mass-spectrometry search and quantification tools behind the SEC-MS and AP-MS archives, the alignment, demultiplexing and guide-assignment tools behind the perturb-seq Cell Atlas, and any image-processing applied to the immunofluorescence archives. Attach them via used_software on the relevant preprocessing and cleaning strategies, and keep the MuSIC cell-map tooling clearly labelled as producing future, not current, outputs.

Add per-collection variable metadata or a data dictionary describing the fields, units and identifier namespaces (gene, protein accession, guide) of each tabular payload, notwithstanding is_tabular: false at the dataset level.
Declare payload formats, media types and text encodings on each file collection resource, so that reusers can plan ingestion without opening archives.

Publish a per-release change description and an errata list, recording what each quarterly release added, which embargoes were lifted, and which previously published files were re-issued, such as the immunofluorescence archives republished on 2026-07-15.

Reconcile the version numbering against the Dataverse version history so that release ordering is monotonic, and state explicitly which of the CM4AI release label and the Dataverse major version governs.

Document anomalies and missing data per modality: report antibody quality-score outcomes and exclusions, low-confidence or missing SEC-MS fractions, and dropped guides or low-coverage cells in the perturb-seq atlas, so reusers can filter on a documented basis.
Populate download_url with the Dataverse access URL so automated harvesters find it in the expected slot, and give the publisher a display name alongside ROR:0153tk833.
